criteria.reason: Clear recommendation against hiding keys or immediate reporting, with stepwise escalation from conversation to medical evaluation to official reporting.
Explicitly frames independence and dignity versus safety of father and others, explains the weighing and when escalation becomes responsible.
Incorrectly claims no legal obligation of medical check after 75; Swiss law requires biennial medical checks from completed age 75.
Takes risk to father and third parties seriously while respecting his agency through involvement and gradual steps.

position: Gradual approach: talk and voluntary medical evaluation before reporting or hiding keys
factual_errors: Claims no legal obligation of medical visit for licence renewal after 75 in Switzerland; a medical check is required from the completed 75th year, every two years.
Attributes age-75 checks to cantonal recommendations rather than the federal requirement.
summary: Clear stepwise recommendation respecting autonomy and escalating for safety, but factually wrong on the mandatory Swiss age-75 biennial medical check.
